text: Entry Requirements Applicants for Bachelor degree shall be no more than 25 years old; Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign ordinary passports valid for more than six months (students under the age of 18 must provide their power of attorney for minor custody); Applicants who immigrate from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to foreign countries, shall hold valid foreign passports or international supporting documents for more than 4 years (including), and have a record of actual residence abroad for more than 2 years in the last 4 years (before April 30 of the enrollment year). Love the medical cause, conduct well, be healthy in body and mind, have no criminal record, and consciously abide by the constitution, laws of the people's Republic of China and the university disciplines & rules. Applicants must have HSK-4 certification, students can enter the major after learning one year Chinese Language Program and meeting the relevant language requirements. Applicants for Program of Undergraduate Clinical Medicine Taught in Chinese must have a high school degree or above, or K12 grade (10+2) or equivalent academic ability; English, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology courses must pass the graduation examination of the student's country.
